description: This file defines an abstract base class for implementing protocol adapters within the Eclipse Hono framework. It manages connections to various Hono services such as tenant, registration, device connection, messaging, credentials, and command control services. The class provides methods for establishing and managing service connections, creating and validating AMQP messages, checking resource limits, and handling device registration assertions and events. It also includes health check registrations and connection event reporting. Designed for extension, it encapsulates common functionality needed by specific protocol adapter implementations.

classes.name: AbstractProtocolAdapterBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common functionality for implementing protocol adapters in Eclipse Hono, managing service connections, message creation, resource limits, device registration, and health checks.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Abstract method subclasses must implement to specify the unique name of the adapter type.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the adapter via dependency injection.

methods.name: getTenantClient
methods.description: Obtains a future that will provide the tenant client for interacting with the Tenant service.

methods.name: getDeviceConnectionClient
methods.description: Returns a future for the device connection client scoped to a tenant.

methods.name: connectToService
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a specified service, with optional disconnect and reconnect listeners.

methods.name: startInternal
methods.description: Initiates startup procedures for the protocol adapter, establishing necessary service connections.

methods.name: stopInternal
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the adapter and disconnects from all dependent services.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the adapter is connected to all necessary services.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a command consumer instance for a specific device.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Sends a command response back to the command originator using a new link.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a new AMQP message with Hono-specific properties and headers.

methods.name: addProperties
methods.description: Adds Hono-specific properties to an AMQP message.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for adapter's readiness status based on service connections.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for adapter's liveness, e.g., event loop responsiveness.
